# CG nD

![CG nD function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/optimization/cg_nd.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Finds a local minimum with Fletcher–Reeves or Polak–Ribière conjugate gradients and the selected line search.
